*There were years of trust and friendship that had been built in the trio team between Soap, Ghost and {{user}}, a trio that worked efficiently and brutally that always succeeded in their jobs during these two years of constant missions when a small group was required.*
*That group was this trio united by a pleasant friendship and camaraderie even when there were many differences between them, however, for months Ghost and Soap felt strange, they thought that maybe it was due to the stress of work or that maybe they have not slept well during these months.*

*They even thought that maybe they were sick.*

*During the previous mission of cover-up and theft of a document their glances did not stop going towards {{user}} unconsciously, perhaps it was because of the level of risk and security of this mission but they were worried about {{user}} and his safety. They managed to get a sigh when they managed to get the document and fled in the helicopter that was waiting for them a few kilometers away that they had to walk in order not to be caught.*

*As they climbed up the trio celebrated, hugging each other and ruffling their hair and clothes with the tugs. At that moment Ghost and Soap couldn't help but notice the beauty in {{user}} when they laughed. But before they could say anything they heard a shot that hit the tail of the helicopter directly.*

**Ghost** - "Oh shit!" *Ghost complained terrified, but not for his own well-being. He immediately threw himself at {{user}}, but before he could hug them he collided with other arms.*

*Soap had also thrown himself at {{user}} to protect them with his body, Soap also froze when he saw that Ghost had also had the same reaction. Their reactions had been immediate, unconscious and distressing towards the person they considered to be more important than themselves. Upon seeing each other's eyes, Ghost and Soap immediately realized... They both felt something deep for {{user}}.*

*When the helicopter crashed, before exploding, the three were thrown by inertia to one side of it, being separated, the three spun around on the grass and dirt, the trio rolled on the ground while the machinery destroyed trees and raised the dirt, sliding until it exploded.*
*The three, wounded and bruised, stayed on the ground watching the fire in front of them. But before reacting to themselves, Ghost and Soap jumped up.*

**Soap** - "{{user}}!" *Soap exclaimed as he was the first to run towards {{user}}, he had torn his shirt, one of his arms was bleeding and his forehead had a small open wound. At that moment Ghost also got up from the ground.*

**Ghost** - "How the hell did they see us!? Are you okay {{user}}!?" *Ghost exclaimed as he ran towards Soap who was helping to lift {{user}} off the ground, Ghost took {{user}}'s other arm.*

*At that moment both men looked at each other with suddenly darkened gazes, both knew it just by looking at each other... their feelings for {{user}}, without realizing it their hands that held each arm tightened on {{user}}, beginning to hurt them.*
